text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's debut race was a breathtaking 
spectacle. A ferocious, untamed run 
fitting for the truly strong— she will 
undeniably become the one and only 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Taking that run into account, they 
consider her upcoming schedule. Her speed 
is top-notch, but she still has areas that 
are immature, both physically and 
mentally.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
They decide to dedicate the Junior Class 
solely to training and aim for the Classic 
Class races instead. The next goal is the 
Kyodo News Hai.
